# Logistics 0.1.2 alpha 15

- Expand Books and Comics reading parity, automatic spreads, fold-aware layouts and native fullscreen magnification.
- Cache remote EPUB archives in memory, dismiss search keyboards on outside taps and keep folder pagination current.
- Expose ordinary iOS Local files through Files and computer file sharing, with resumable relocation of private state to Application Support and backup exclusion.
- Consolidate rclone transfer review, retries, direct readers and multiple saved or session-only credential packages.
- Coalesce pending transfer progress, preserving terminal state and rejecting stale callbacks.
- Add Mac launchers for signed Android Firebase betas and sequential device/beta deployments, with protected local signing state.
- Synchronize the progressive-search fixture with real durable checkpoints before measuring query delivery; preserve partial-result and cancellation assertions.
- Exercise actual iOS storage migration APIs on disposable native fixtures and retain detailed transfer-review timeout diagnostics.

The iOS TestFlight application version is 0.1.6. Publication requires all desktop platform, native mobile and mobile runtime checks to pass. This candidate includes the latest committed commonUtils and Logistics changes and supersedes the earlier unpublished candidates.
